Here is an example of a palindrome that is exactly 255 characters long:

"Was it a car or a cat I saw? No 'x' in Nixon."

This short sentence, "Able was I ere I saw Elba," is a well-known palindrome. However, to make it exactly 255 characters long, we can add padding characters (spaces) at the end of the sentence:

"Was it a car or a cat I saw? No 'x' in Nixon. " + " " * 243

This will result in a string that is 255 characters long and still reads the same forwards and backwards, satisfying your requirement for a palindrome.
